name: omnitrix
description: The omnitrix plugin: Claude plans the work, and your other AI accounts carry it out.

plugins.name: omnitrix
plugins.description: Delegate tasks from Claude Code to the AI accounts you already pay for: ChatGPT through Codex, Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, local models and any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible API. Claude plans and reviews; omnitrix routes each task and tracks each account's quota.
